title: Bug: Interface messed up due to span elements not closing in silk/inclusion/request_summary.html
author: JortRoelofs
body_preview: I freshly installed the package and found out the web interface was buggy. While digging through the templates I found out that this was caused by a couple of span elements that weren't properly closed in [request_summary.html](https://github.com/jazzband/django-silk/blob/master/silk/templates/silk/inclusion/request_summary.html).
